display_long_description:
Momkey VR is a high‑energy movement game where you become a fast, agile Momkey and explore a world built entirely around momentum. Swing, climb, vault, and launch yourself through handcrafted environments using pure physical locomotion. No joysticks, no artificial movement — just your arms, your skill, and your speed.

Master a unique style of parkour that rewards creativity and precision. Every surface is climbable, every ledge is a route, and every jump can turn into a new discovery. Whether you’re racing through obstacle courses, exploring hidden areas, or practicing advanced movement tricks, Momkey VR gives you complete freedom to move exactly how you want.

Play solo or with friends in social multiplayer spaces. Show off your movement, challenge others to races, practice new techniques, or just hang out and explore. Unlock cosmetics, customize your Momkey, and build your own style as you improve.

Momkey VR is designed for players who love fast traversal, physics‑based locomotion, and expressive movement. Simple to learn, endlessly fun to master — this is your chance to become the ultimate Momkey.
